text: The future of artificial intelligence is a topic that attracts a lot of attention. Today we have "narrow" AI, which is good at specific tasks like translating languages or recommending films. However, many researchers are working towards artificial general intelligence (AGI) – a system that can understand and learn any task a human can do. Supporters believe AGI could help solve major global problems, such as disease and climate change. On the other hand, critics warn about serious risks, including job losses and the difficulty of keeping such powerful systems under control. Predictions about when AGI might arrive vary widely. Some experts say it could happen within twenty years, while others think it is still far away.
